title: Structural insight to human Retinoid X receptor alpha-Thyroid hormone receptor beta heterodimer by molecular modelling and MD-simulation studies: role of conserved water molecules.
authors: Mukherjee, Soumita; Dasgupta, Subrata; Panja, Sujit Sankar; Adhikari, Utpal
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子建模与MD模拟研究RXRα-THRβ异二聚体与DNA复合物，揭示保守水分子介导TF-DNA结合界面识别及配体调控机制，高度契合TF-DNA互作动态机理建模课题。
abstract: The Retinoid X receptor alpha-Thyroid hormone receptor beta (RXRalpha-THRbeta) heterodimer plays an important role in physiological function of humans specially in the growth and development. Extensive MD-simulation studies on the aquated complexes of modelled RXRalpha-THRbeta heterodimer with DNA-duplex have indicated the role of some conserved/semiconserved water molecules in the complexation process in presence or absence of Triiodothyronine (T3) and 9-cis retinoic acid (9CR) in the respective Ligand Binding Domain (LBD) domain. Among the seventeen conserved/semi-conserved water molecules, the W1-W4 water centers have been observed to mediate the interaction between the residues of A-chain (DBD of RXR) to consensus sequence (C-chain) of DNA. The W5-W8 water centers involve in recognition of the residues of B-chain (DBD of THR) to C-chain of DNA. The W9-W13 centers have connected the different residues of B-chain (THR) to D-chain of DNA through H-bonds, whereas W14-W17 water molecules were involved in the interaction of A-chain(')s (RXR) residues to D-chain of DNA. In our previous study with homodimeric THRbeta from Rattus norvegicus we have identified fifteen conserved water molecules at the DNA-DBD interface. Moreover, the conformational flexibility of Met313 (in the LBD of THR) from open to close form in presence or absence of T3 molecule in the holo and Apo-protein may provide a plausible rational on the possible role of that residue to acts as gate which could restrict the solvent molecules to enter into the hydrophobic T3-binding pocket of LBD during the absence of ligand molecule and thus could help the stabilization of that domain in THRbeta structure.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 维甲酸X受体α-甲状腺激素受体β（RXRalpha-THRbeta）异源二聚体在人类生理功能中，特别是在生长发育过程中，扮演着重要角色。对模拟的RXRalpha-THRbeta异源二聚体与DNA双链体的水合复合物进行的广泛分子动力学（MD）模拟研究表明，在相应配体结合域（LBD）中存在或不存在三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）和9-顺式维甲酸（9CR）的情况下，一些保守/半保守水分子在复合过程中发挥作用。在十七个保守/半保守水分子中，观察到W1-W4水中心介导A链（RXR的DBD）残基与DNA共有序列（C链）之间的相互作用。W5-W8水中心参与识别B链（THR的DBD）残基与DNA的C链。W9-W13中心通过氢键连接B链（THR）的不同残基与DNA的D链，而W14-W17水分子则参与A链（RXR）残基与DNA的D链之间的相互作用。在我们之前对来自褐家鼠的同源二聚体THRbeta的研究中，我们鉴定了十五个位于DNA-DBD界面的保守水分子。此外，在holo和Apo蛋白中，Met313（位于THR的LBD中）在存在或不存在T3分子时从开放构象到闭合构象的构象灵活性，可能为该残基作为门控的潜在作用提供合理推测，即在缺乏配体分子时，该门控可限制溶剂分子进入LBD的疏水性T3结合口袋，从而有助于稳定THRbeta结构中的该结构域。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
